text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear introduction and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is structured into an opening, body paragraphs, and a wrap-up that makes its argument easy to follow."},{"evidence":"topic sentences like 'PRACTICE.MAKES.PERFECT.' and 'Do something different from everybody else.'","quality":"paragraph development","description":"The essay develops distinct points in separate paragraphs rather than staying at one repeated level of narration."},{"evidence":"examples of basketball and an online class","quality":"supporting detail","description":"The essay backs its claims with specific personal examples that explain the main idea."},{"evidence":"sentences such as 'How can someone be better without practicing.'","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows more control over complete sentence structure, even though it still has errors."},{"evidence":"phrases like 'getting out of your comfort zone' and 'beyond your wildest dreams'","quality":"academic phrasing","description":"The essay uses more developed, school-like language to express ideas and connect them to the prompt."},{"evidence":"transitions like 'Furthermore,' 'However,' and 'In conclusion,'","quality":"cohesive transitions","description":"The essay more clearly links ideas with discourse markers that guide the reader through its reasoning."}]}
